shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣戴着绝缘手套，旁边是高压警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears insulating gloves and stands beside a high voltage warning sign.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电工作业与电压等级。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 实验室墙上插座面板松了，阿杰拿起螺丝刀
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket cover in the lab hangs loose and the young male student picks up a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 插座面板松了，阿杰想自己修。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他说：我做过电路实验，会接线
shots.prompt_en: He shrugs confidently in front of the loose socket, screwdriver in hand.
shots.narration: 他想：做过电路实验，我会接。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老周按住他的手，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man puts a hand on his arm and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 老周说：这是电工作业，你不能干。

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证上岗，学生不拆修
shots.scene: 老李出示一张空白的操作证卡片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows a blank certificate card with an electric bolt icon.
shots.narration: 电工作业，必须持证上岗。
overlay: 电工作业持证上岗，学生不拆修

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证上岗，学生不拆修
shots.scene: 学生拆插座、拆仪器电源柜、改线路三个图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student opening a socket, opening an instrument power supply cabinet and rewiring a circuit, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不拆插座电源柜，不改线路。

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证上岗，学生不拆修
shots.scene: 电工修线路，学生正确使用和报修，分成两栏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two columns, an electrician repairing wiring and a student using equipment and filing a repair request. No text.
shots.narration: 电工修线路，我们管使用和报修。

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证上岗，学生不拆修
shots.scene: 电气事故人群图标中，未经培训的人占多数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a group of accident icons, most of them figures without a training badge. No text.
shots.narration: 电气事故，很多出在没受训的人。

shots.section_title: 电工作业持证上岗，学生不拆修
shots.scene: 家里墙上开关，阿杰打电话请电工
shots.prompt_en: The young male student at home looks at a wall switch and makes a phone call to an electrician.
shots.narration: 家里改线路，也请持证电工。

shots.section_title: 一律当作带电：停电、验电、挂接地线
shots.scene: 所有电线和设备都闪着假想的电流符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: every cable and device shows an imagined lightning symbol, as if live. No text.
shots.narration: 任何线路设备，先当作带电。
overlay: 一律当作带电：停电、验电、挂接地线

shots.section_title: 一律当作带电：停电、验电、挂接地线
shots.scene: 停电、验电、挂接地线、挂牌设遮栏四步图示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four steps in a row, switch off, test for voltage, attach an earthing set, hang a sign and set up a barrier. No text.
shots.narration: 电工按步骤：停电、验电、接地、挂牌。

shots.section_title: 一律当作带电：停电、验电、挂接地线
shots.scene: 老李用验电器确认无电，学生在旁观看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a disconnected circuit with a voltage detector while a student watches from a distance.
shots.narration: 觉得断了电，也要验明无电。

shots.section_title: 一律当作带电：停电、验电、挂接地线
shots.scene: 沟通出错，有人在别处合上了开关，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one worker on a circuit while someone elsewhere switches it back on, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 沟通出错没断干净，最危险。

shots.section_title: 一律当作带电：停电、验电、挂接地线
shots.scene: 配电箱开关上锁挂牌，指向另一课图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lock and a tag on a switched off breaker, an arrow pointing to a lesson book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，见第144课。

shots.section_title: 有人监护，送电前呼唱确认
shots.scene: 老李作业，王老师在旁边监护
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works on a panel while the safety administrator stands beside him as a safety watcher.
shots.narration: 电气作业，旁边要有人监护。
overlay: 有人监护，送电前呼唱确认

shots.section_title: 有人监护，送电前呼唱确认
shots.scene: 深夜独自一人检修，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lone person repairing a panel late at night, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不一个人干，深夜不独自作业。

shots.section_title: 有人监护，送电前呼唱确认
shots.scene: 监护人一手拉闸，一手打电话
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the watcher switching off the main switch with one hand and phoning for help with the other. No text.
shots.narration: 出事了，监护人立即断电呼救。

shots.section_title: 有人监护，送电前呼唱确认
shots.scene: 送电前，老李大声问，王老师回答
shots.prompt_en: Before restoring power, the facility engineer calls out and the safety administrator answers after checking.
shots.narration: 送电前问：人员工具都撤了吗？

shots.section_title: 有人监护，送电前呼唱确认
shots.scene: 确认后才合闸；不喊不应合闸打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: power restored only after a confirmed answer, a tick; switching on without calling out, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 确认答复才合闸，不喊不应不送电。

shots.section_title: 作业前：摘饰品、脚下干燥、评估电弧
shots.scene: 摘下戒指、手表，收好挂绳和袖口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring and a watch being taken off, a lanyard tucked away and sleeves fastened. No text.
shots.narration: 动手前，摘下戒指手表。
overlay: 作业前：摘饰品、脚下干燥、评估电弧

shots.section_title: 作业前：摘饰品、脚下干燥、评估电弧
shots.scene: 金属手表碰到端子打火，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal watch strap touching a terminal and sparking, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 金属饰品导电，会短路烫伤。

shots.section_title: 作业前：摘饰品、脚下干燥、评估电弧
shots.scene: 地面有水、鞋子潮湿两个图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wet floor and damp shoes, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 地上有水、鞋子潮湿，不作业。

shots.section_title: 作业前：摘饰品、脚下干燥、评估电弧
shots.scene: 老李站在绝缘垫上作业
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on a rubber insulating mat in front of a panel.
shots.narration: 地面擦干，站在绝缘垫上。

shots.section_title: 作业前：摘饰品、脚下干燥、评估电弧
shots.scene: 测试前填写一张空白风险评估表，有电弧图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank risk assessment sheet with an arc flash icon before electrical testing. No text.
shots.narration: 电气测试按标准，先评估电弧风险。

shots.section_title: 电工检修时不围观、不乱碰
shots.scene: 检修现场拉起隔离带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a barrier tape set up around an electrician working on a panel. No text.
shots.narration: 电工检修，周围会设隔离。
overlay: 电工检修时不围观、不乱碰

shots.section_title: 电工检修时不围观、不乱碰
shots.scene: 学生凑近围观、伸手碰开关，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students crowding in and one reaching for a switch near the work area, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别凑近围观，别碰工具和开关。

shots.section_title: 电工检修时不围观、不乱碰
shots.scene: 学生在门外等，老李示意恢复供电
shots.prompt_en: The students wait outside the door until the facility engineer gives a thumbs up that power is restored.
shots.narration: 听安排，等通知再用电。

shots.section_title: 电压等级：低压、高压与输电分级
shots.scene: 电压阶梯图：低压、高压两级
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage staircase with a low step and a high step. No text.
shots.narration: 电压分低压和高压。
overlay: 电压等级：低压、高压与输电分级

shots.section_title: 电压等级：低压、高压与输电分级
shots.scene: 分界线上画问号，旁边一本标准书图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dividing line between the two steps with a question mark and a standards book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 界限多少，以国家现行标准为准。

shots.section_title: 电压等级：低压、高压与输电分级
shots.scene: 园区配电室、楼宇变压器图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a campus substation and a building transformer icon. No text.
shots.narration: 园区楼宇配电，只由专业人员操作。

shots.section_title: 电压等级：低压、高压与输电分级
shots.scene: 输电铁塔三级：高压、超高压、特高压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three transmission towers of increasing height. No text.
shots.narration: 输电线路还分高压、超高压、特高压。

shots.section_title: 电压等级：低压、高压与输电分级
shots.scene: 高压设备旁电弧伸向靠近的人形，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arc jumping from high voltage equipment toward a figure that came too close, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 高压不用碰到，靠近就会被击。

shots.section_title: 低压不等于安全
shots.scene: 墙上插座标着220伏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wall socket with a voltage icon. No text.
shots.narration: 我们日常用的电，属于低压。

shots.section_title: 低压不等于安全
shots.scene: 220伏插座旁画着心脏和闪电，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a socket next to a heart icon struck by a lightning bolt, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 220伏照样能致命。

shots.section_title: 低压不等于安全
shots.scene: 欣欣摆手：低压不等于安全
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw warningly in front of a socket.
shots.narration: 低压不等于安全，千万别大意。

shots.section_title: 高压区域：不靠近、不进入、不攀爬
shots.scene: 变压器、配电室、高压柜三个图标，前面挂警示标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transformer, a switch room door and a high voltage cabinet, each with a high voltage warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 变压器、配电室、高压柜，不靠近。
overlay: 高压区域：不靠近、不进入、不攀爬

shots.section_title: 高压区域：不靠近、不进入、不攀爬
shots.scene: 户外高压设备围着高围栏，学生在栏外止步
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: outdoor high voltage equipment behind a tall fence, a student stopping outside it. No text.
shots.narration: 看到围栏和标志，止步。

shots.section_title: 高压区域：不靠近、不进入、不攀爬
shots.scene: 学生想推开配电室的门，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student trying to open a switch room door, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没有授权，不进配电室变电站。

shots.section_title: 高压区域：不靠近、不进入、不攀爬
shots.scene: 攀爬电杆、铁塔，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure climbing a utility pole and a pylon, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电杆、铁塔、变压器，不攀爬。

shots.section_title: 与架空线路保持安全距离
shots.scene: 架空线周围一圈虚线安全区，人和工具在圈外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overhead power line with a dashed safety zone around it, a person and tools outside the zone. No text.
shots.narration: 架空线周围，有一圈不能进的范围。
overlay: 与架空线路保持安全距离

shots.section_title: 与架空线路保持安全距离
shots.scene: 电压越高，虚线圈越大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three overhead lines, the dashed zone growing larger as the line gets higher. No text.
shots.narration: 电压越高，要离得越远。

shots.section_title: 与架空线路保持安全距离
shots.scene: 一本规程图标和供电部门图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety rules book icon and a power supply company icon. No text.
shots.narration: 距离按现行电力安全规程执行。

shots.section_title: 与架空线路保持安全距离
shots.scene: 有人凑近高压线试试看，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure reaching toward a high voltage line just to see, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不碰也会放电，别凑近试。

shots.section_title: 与架空线路保持安全距离
shots.scene: 高处作业的人离电线太近，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person working at height too close to a power line, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 高处作业，同样远离电力线。

shots.section_title: 吊臂长杆防碰线，机械靠近先报批
shots.scene: 吊车吊臂碰到电线，电流沿车身传下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crane boom touching an overhead line, current running down the vehicle, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 最常见事故：吊臂碰到电线。
overlay: 吊臂长杆防碰线，机械靠近先报批

shots.section_title: 吊臂长杆防碰线，机械靠近先报批
shots.scene: 站在车旁的人也被电流波及
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: current spreading from the vehicle into the ground and reaching a bystander, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 旁边站着的人，也会受伤。

shots.section_title: 吊臂长杆防碰线，机械靠近先报批
shots.scene: 野外采样，阿杰扛长采样杆，先抬头看电线
shots.prompt_en: On a field trip the young male student carries a long sampling pole and looks up at power lines before moving.
shots.narration: 长杆、长梯，放平走，先抬头看。

shots.section_title: 吊臂长杆防碰线，机械靠近先报批
shots.scene: 风筝和无人机在电线附近，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a kite and a drone near power lines, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 风筝无人机，去空旷处放。

shots.section_title: 吊臂长杆防碰线，机械靠近先报批
shots.scene: 王老师审批机械靠近线路作业申请，有人监护
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank work request for machinery near a line, with a watcher assigned.
shots.narration: 机械靠近线路，先报批，专人监护。

shots.section_title: 电线断落：远离、小步离开、报告
shots.scene: 电线断落在地，周围一圈危险区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fallen power line on the ground with a danger zone around it. No text.
shots.narration: 电线断落，周围地面也可能带电。
overlay: 电线断落：远离、小步离开、报告

shots.section_title: 电线断落：远离、小步离开、报告
shots.scene: 人双脚并拢小步跳离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure moving away with both feet together in small shuffling steps. No text.
shots.narration: 已在附近，双脚并拢，小步离开。

shots.section_title: 电线断落：远离、小步离开、报告
shots.scene: 小研在远处看守，保卫处值班员接电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student keeps people away from a distance while the security officer answers a phone.
shots.narration: 专人看守，报告保卫处和供电部门。

shots.section_title: 电线断落：远离、小步离开、报告
shots.scene: 雷雨中有人碰室外电线杆，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure touching a utility pole in a thunderstorm, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 雷雨天，不碰室外电线电杆。

shots.section_title: 电气作业防护：面罩、护目镜、头罩
shots.scene: 电工全套防护：面罩、头罩、手套、鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrician in full electrical protective gear, face shield, hood, gloves and boots. No text.
shots.narration: 电工作业，穿戴防护一样不少。
overlay: 电气作业防护：面罩、护目镜、头罩

shots.section_title: 电气作业防护：面罩、护目镜、头罩
shots.scene: 防护挡住触电、电弧和灼伤三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: protective gear blocking three hazard icons, a shock, an arc flash and a burn. No text.
shots.narration: 挡住触电、电弧和灼伤。

shots.section_title: 电气作业防护：面罩、护目镜、头罩
shots.scene: 防电弧面罩挡住飞溅的熔化金属
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arc rated face shield blocking molten metal and flying fragments. No text.
shots.narration: 防电弧面罩，护住整张脸。

shots.section_title: 电气作业防护：面罩、护目镜、头罩
shots.scene: 不导电、耐冲击的护目镜和防电弧头罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: non conductive impact resistant safety goggles and an arc rated hood covering head, neck and shoulders. No text.
shots.narration: 护目镜不导电，头罩护头颈肩。

shots.section_title: 电气作业防护：面罩、护目镜、头罩
shots.scene: 在旁协助的人也戴好防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper standing beside the electrician also wearing protective gear. No text.
shots.narration: 在旁协助，也要做好防护。

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套、绝缘鞋和绝缘垫
shots.scene: 绝缘手套按电压等级选，几副手套对应不同等级
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several pairs of insulating gloves matched to different voltage level icons. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘手套，额定电压要相符。
overlay: 绝缘手套、绝缘鞋和绝缘垫

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套、绝缘鞋和绝缘垫
shots.scene: 【实拍】合格电绝缘鞋和绝缘垫的标识特写（遮挡品牌和型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the markings on a pair of electrical insulating boots and an insulating rubber mat.
shots.narration: 绝缘鞋、绝缘垫，选合格产品。

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套、绝缘鞋和绝缘垫
shots.scene: 人站绝缘垫穿绝缘靴，电流找不到通路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person on an insulating mat in insulating boots, a current path to the ground blocked. No text.
shots.narration: 把人和大地隔开，电流没通路。

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套、绝缘鞋和绝缘垫
shots.scene: 绝缘用品旁边是断电开关，打钩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: insulating gear shown together with a switched off breaker, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘用品是补充，不能代替断电。

shots.section_title: 绝缘用品用前查、定期检验
shots.scene: 【实拍】双手把绝缘手套从袖口卷起，挤压查漏气，再看有无裂纹（不接触任何电源）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands rolling an insulating glove from the cuff to trap air and checking for leaks and cracks.
shots.narration: 手套用前查：漏气、破损、裂纹。
overlay: 绝缘用品用前查、定期检验

shots.section_title: 绝缘用品用前查、定期检验
shots.scene: 【实拍】查看螺丝刀、钳子的绝缘手柄有无裂纹破损（工具未接触电源）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands turning an insulated screwdriver and pliers, inspecting the handles for cracks.
shots.narration: 工具绝缘柄裂了，就换掉。

shots.section_title: 绝缘用品用前查、定期检验
shots.scene: 检验日期标签和日历，过期的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inspection date tag on insulating gear next to a calendar, an expired one crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 按规定定期检验，过期不用。

shots.section_title: 绝缘用品用前查、定期检验
shots.scene: 绝缘用品擦净，放进干燥柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: insulating gloves and boots wiped clean and stored in a dry cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 用后清洁，干燥存放。

shots.section_title: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品
shots.scene: 普通线手套、雨靴、安全帽三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: ordinary cotton work gloves, rain boots and a hard hat. No text.
shots.narration: 普通手套鞋帽，是劳保用品。
overlay: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品

shots.section_title: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品
shots.scene: 戴线手套去碰电线，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand in a cotton work glove reaching for a wire, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 雨靴破手套，都不能当绝缘用品。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 操作证、四步图、监护人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a certificate card, the four step safety measures and a safety watcher. No text.
shots.narration: 持证作业，停电验电接地，有人监护。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 低压插座、高压围栏、架空线安全圈
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a socket, a high voltage fence and an overhead line with a dashed safety zone. No text.
shots.narration: 低压也致命，高压不靠近，线下留距离。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 绝缘手套、绝缘鞋、线手套打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: insulating gloves and boots with a tick, and cotton work gloves crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘用品要合格，劳保不等于绝缘。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣搓了搓手，头上有一小团静电火花
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rubs its paws together and a tiny static spark pops above its head.
shots.narration: 下一课：静电与防爆电气。
